name: brand-reference-scout
description: Find B-roll that fits your existing campaigns, then choose it in a private two-up review.

interface.longDescription: Bring brand context, campaign examples and a concrete brief. Scout uses your current agent and existing footage sources to curate ten playable B-roll references, then opens a private review with selections and sourced exports.
defaultPrompt: Find B-roll for my campaign from my brand and previous work.
